text: The defining condition on the boundary maps of a chain complex ⋯ → Cₙ → Cₙ₋₁ → ⋯ is:
choices: d ∘ d = 0, i.e. dₙ₋₁ ∘ dₙ = 0 for all n
explanation: 'The boundary of a boundary is zero' gives im(dₙ₊₁) ⊆ ker(dₙ), which is exactly what makes homology Hₙ = ker dₙ / im dₙ₊₁ well defined. Exactness is the stronger condition im = ker.
